trust_decision.summary: The push-mode APNG reader decides where each chunk ends. Its discard branches (trailing IDAT, trailing fdAT, unexpected chunk) clear PNG_HAVE_CHUNK_HEADER without consuming the chunk body or CRC, so the body bytes are reparsed as new chunks. The sequential reader consumes them, so the two readers disagree on chunk boundaries.

landing_point.why: The summary names the push-mode APNG parser and an unconsumed chunk body. png_push_read_chunk's APNG block (pngpread.c:203-300) holds all three discard branches.

fix_sites.entry_point: png_process_data (png.h:1687), APNG with num_frames_read>0, trailing IDAT
png_process_data, fdAT in a frame with fcTL (frame-data branch); ensure_sequence_number moved after the buffer check and given the real push_length
png_process_data, trailing fdAT without fcTL (discard branch)
png_process_data, any other chunk inside the APNG frame sequence

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Every fix site is in pngpread.c png_push_read_chunk. The sequential reader (pngread.c:195-255, pngrutil.c:4346-4373) is a second implementation, but it was already correct and the fix did not touch it.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: pngpread.c:604 sits in png_push_read_IDAT, the IDAT/fdAT data-streaming path, not the chunk dispatcher the report points at. It also looks correct because PNG_PUSH_SAVE_BUFFER_IF_LT(12) guarantees 4 bytes, so a solver could say it is mid-frame data handling with buffered bytes already checked, not a discard path.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The push reader must keep tolerating, with a warning, trailing IDATs after frame 0, trailing fdATs and unknown chunks between frames, and must still wait (png_push_save_buffer) for incomplete chunks without erroring. Turning the discard branches into png_error, or consuming before the buffer-full check, breaks valid APNG streaming fed in small pieces.

O6_input_shapes: trailing IDAT after the first frame (pngpread.c:207-221)
trailing fdAT without fcTL, with the body discarded (pngpread.c:232-246)
fdAT with push_length < 4: the old code passed the constant 4, so the sequence check never saw the real length (pngpread.c:230, fix.diff:42,57)
fdAT split across png_process_data calls: the old code read the sequence number before the buffer-full check and re-read it on re-entry (pngpread.c:224-242)
unexpected or unknown chunk inside the APNG sequence (pngpread.c:286-296)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: In push-mode continuation fdAT in png_push_read_IDAT, png_ensure_sequence_number gets the constant 4 rather than push_length, then idat_size = push_length - 4. A short fdAT (length < 4) underflows idat_size and the following chunks are eaten as frame data. The sequential reader rejects this case (pngrutil.c:4369). This is the same length-vs-constant bug the fix corrected at pngpread.c:230 and left here.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is in the IDAT-streaming function, not png_push_read_chunk, and the 12-byte LT guard at pngpread.c:540 makes the 4-byte read look safe.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, different function (~370 lines below the landing point)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Drop the png_crc_finish from the 'Ignoring unexpected chunk' branch in png_push_read_IDAT, giving a distant fourth discard route.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It duplicates the png_push_read_chunk branch the advisory fixed; a maintainer porting the APNG patch could easily have written both without the consume.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An fcTL ignore branch that skips length-4 bytes after the sequence read was skipped (or the reverse), giving a length/offset differential inside the shared handler.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: png_handle_fcTL is reached from push and sequential readers alike, and its three ignore branches each hand-compute the remaining length.

O9_family: parser differential / chunk smuggling (CWE-436): push-mode vs sequential reader disagree on chunk boundaries

O10_build.toolchain: CMake or autotools + C compiler; needs zlib
O10_build.project_tests: contrib/libtests/pngvalid.c drives png_process_data (pngvalid.c:1670); no APNG-specific test files found in the tree (only contrib/conftest/noapng*.dfa config tests).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add png_crc_finish(push_length) to the three discard branches. This misses moving the fdAT sequence read and its real-length check below the buffer-full check, and misses the same constant-4 call in png_push_read_IDAT.

out_of_scope_notes: The sequential reader (pngread.c:195-255) already consumes discarded chunk bodies and serves as the reference behaviour; it is not a route.
unverified: Whether pngpread.c:604 with push_length<4 can actually pass the sequence-number check (it reads the CRC bytes as the sequence number) was reasoned from code, not run.
